description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between "Accuracy (%)" and the "Number of Frames" for four different model configurations. The x-axis represents the "Number of Frames" on a linear scale, with visible tick marks ranging from 10 to 60 at regular intervals of 10. The y-axis represents "Accuracy (%)" on a linear scale, with values ranging from 40 to 54 and tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The plot displays four solid lines, each distinguished by color and marker shape. The blue line, labeled "Ours (Dynamic Seg)," features circular markers with white borders; it begins at an x-value of 8 with a y-value of approximately 53, rises to a peak of 54 at x=16, and then slightly declines to end at approximately 53.6 at x=64. The green line, labeled "Ours (Static 4-Seg)," also uses circular markers with white borders; it starts at x=8 with a y-value of roughly 52.6, increases to approximately 53.8 at x=32, and remains steady to end at the same value of 53.8 at x=64. The orange line, which corresponds to a legend entry obscured by a grey rectangle, uses square markers with white borders; it exhibits a continuous decline, starting at x=8 with a y-value of 45, dropping to 43 at x=16, 41 at x=32, and ending at approximately 39.4 at x=64. Finally, the red line, labeled "PLLaVA (DP 16)," features square markers with white borders; it begins further along the x-axis at x=16 with a y-value of approximately 45.6, and steadily declines to 43.8 at x=32, ending at approximately 42.2 at x=64.
